title: A measure Hⁿ⌞g whose own density g is 0-homogeneous and positive somewhere has infinite mass (parent (A.3)(1) and step 8)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, g : ℝ^P → ℝ and x₀ ∈ ℝ^P. Assume: g(x) = (limsup_{ρ→0⁺} μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ))).toReal for every x (limsup in [0, ∞] along 𝓝[>]0, open balls, ω_n = unitBallVolume n); μ = Hⁿ.withDensity(x ↦ ofReal(g(x))) with Hⁿ = μHE[n]; g(t·x) = g(x) for every t > 0 and every x; and g(x₀) > 0. Then μ(ℝ^P) = ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (x₀ : Euclid P), 1 ≤ n → (∀ x, g x = (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal) → μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x, g (t • x) = g x) → 0 < g x₀ → μ univ = ∞
